about: cesr.parse cases for JSON field maps framed by a version string at the top level of a stream. The bodies carry only what the version-string rules need plus a few ordinary fields; they are not KERI events and nothing here checks KERI semantics. A message item reports the protocol, the protocol version, the serialization kind and the size the version string declares.

cases.title: Frame a JSON body by its 2.XX version string, then its attachments
cases.description: A genus/version code, a JSON field map whose first field v is a 2.XX version string (protocol KERI, protocol version 2.0, genus version 2.00, kind JSON, size in four Base64 digits, terminator '.'), then an attachments group (-C) holding a controller signature group (-K) of one indexed signature. The parser must take the body's length from its version string to find where the attachments begin.

cases.title: Frame a JSON body by its legacy 1.XX version string
cases.description: A JSON field map whose v field is a legacy 1.XX version string (protocol KERI, version 1.0 in two hex digits, kind JSON, size in six lowercase hex digits, terminator '_'). Version 2.XX implementations must still support this format.

cases.title: Frame consecutive JSON bodies with 2.XX and 1.XX version strings
cases.description: Two JSON field maps back to back with no count code between them: the first with a 2.XX version string, the second with a legacy 1.XX one. Each body's end comes only from its own version string.
